_comment: generateContent response payloads for the storyline labeler's tests
(ADR-0011). The tests must never reach the live API, so these stand in for
it — but every SHAPE here was confirmed against the real endpoint, most
on 2026-08-14 while the labeler was first run against it, including the two
that cost a label in that run: `truncated` (a reasoning model spending its
whole output budget on thoughts) and the 503. `usageMetadata` is where the
cost-per-thousand estimate in docs/STORYLINE-LABELS.md comes from.
`thinking` is the LATER shape, recorded 2026-08-28: the same endpoint and
the same model now split the candidate into a `thought: true` part and the
answer. Every fixture above it predates that and has a single bare part,
which is why none of them caught the client concatenating the two.
